name: Chepa Pulusu (Telangana Style)
instructions: 1. Marinate the fish with salt, turmeric, and a little chili powder for 15 minutes. 2. Heat sesame oil in a wide pan or earthen pot, add mustard, cumin, and fenugreek seeds. 3. Add chopped onions, green chilies, and curry leaves; sauté until golden brown. 4. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook until the raw smell disappears. 5. Mix in turmeric, chili powder, and coriander powder, then add the tamarind pulp along with water. 6. Bring the gravy to a boil and let it simmer until it thickens slightly. 7. Carefully place the fish pieces into the boiling gravy and cook on medium heat without stirring too much. 8. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
description: Chepa Pulusu is a quintessential Telangana dish known for its bold, spicy, and tangy flavor profile. It is traditionally cooked in an earthen pot (mannu patram), which imparts an earthy aroma, making it a beloved staple during family gatherings and festivals in the region.
